text:
nora: Heads up  drop-in client (no RSVP) just pinged me, planning to arrive ~10:20. Can reception badge them quickly?
frontdesk-bot: @nora noted. Please DM full names for pre-printing. Kiosk C warmed up. :printer:
nora: Names are Priya Kapoor and Marcus Lo. They're doing a quick floor tour and might grab a hotdesk for an hour.
people-ops: Pre-printed badges will be in the "Pre-printed" tray. Remind guests to show ID. If they need a parking pass, we have one left for Lot B.
sam: Can you hold the Lot B pass for me? I'm expecting a contractor at 10:15 and might need it.
people-ops: Reserved pass for @sam. Pick up at reception.
jules: Small note  a courier just left a package at Reception labelled "Prototype Kit / Redwood Demo" but no recipient. It was left at 09:12. Locker 4D. :package:
courier-bot: Package info: carrier 'QuickDrop', tracking QD-334455, marked 'handle with care'. Sticker lists 'For: Jamie R.' but no team.
nora: That might be the demo hardware for today's visit. I'm with Jamie's team; please don't open.
people-ops: We'll hold sealed. If owner not claimed by EOD, we'll log and return to sender. Also reminder to hosts: return temp badges to badge dropbox after the visit.
sam: If Jamie isn't around, I'll collect and keep in 2B until pickup. Also, anyone want the HDMI dongle from the kit?
jules: I could use it for the standup. If it's in the sealed box, please sign it out on the package log.
frontdesk-bot: Reception update: Badges printed and banded with Lot B pass. Package logged in locker 4D under 'Hold-for-Jamie'.
nora: Thanks team  I'll meet them in the lobby at 10:15 and escort them up. Heads up: guests might ask for visitor-WiFi; use 'VISITOR-24h' card.
people-ops: Noted. Added entry to today's visitor ledger for reconciliation. Reminder: visitor badges expire after 8 hours and should be returned. :white_check_mark:
